title: Majority noise stability lower bound
statement: For every natural number $m$ and every real number $\rho$ with $0<\rho<1$, the noise stability at correlation $\rho$ of the majority function on $2m+1$ signs, represented as a real-valued function, is at least $\frac{2}{\pi}\arcsin(\rho)$.
